description: This is a test configuration and fixture setup file for pytest used in a FastAPI application. It includes fixtures to initialize the app, test client, and user authentication tokens, as well as a fixture to reset the in-memory store state between tests to ensure isolation.

methods.name: app()
methods.description: Creates and returns a new FastAPI application instance for each test.

methods.name: client(app)
methods.description: Provides a TestClient bound to the app instance for each test.

methods.name: _isolate_store_state()
methods.description: Resets the singleton in-memory STORE to a clean state before each test to prevent test interference.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _auth_login(client: TestClient, email: str, password: str = "any")
methods.description: Performs login and returns authentication details such as access token and user info.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict[str,Any]] quality_token_and_user(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Provides a fixture returning token and user info for a seeded quality user.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict[str,Any]] admin_token_and_user(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Provides a fixture returning token and user info for a seeded admin user.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict[str,Any]] production_token_and_user(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Provides a fixture returning token and user info for a seeded production user.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] auth_headers(token: str)
methods.description: Creates an authorization header dictionary given a token.

ctags.name: _auth_login
ctags.pattern: /^def _auth_login(client: TestClient, email: str, password: str = "any") -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
